enriched_activities.desc: Lie on the bed with the quilt over the body. Turn the head to the side. Keep the eyes closed. Remain lying still. Turn onto the left side. Pull the quilt up to the shoulder. Shift the legs. Turn onto the back. Place one arm under the pillow. Turn onto the right side. Adjust the pillow with the hand. Remain lying on the bed. Move the arm onto the quilt. Shift the position of the legs. Keep the eyes closed. Remain lying on the bed until the alarm rings.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up on the bed. Swing the legs off the bed. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom. Open the bathroom door. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Cup water in both hands. Splash water onto the face. Pick up the towel from the hook. Wipe the face dry. Hang the towel back on the hook. Pick up the toothbrush. Wet the toothbrush under the tap. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Put the toothpaste tube down on the shelf. Brush the teeth. Rinse the mouth with water. Spit into the sink. Rinse the toothbrush. Put the toothbrush back in the holder. Turn off the tap. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the eggs and the bread. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Pick up the kettle. Walk to the sink. Turn on the tap. Fill the kettle with water. Turn off the tap. Place the kettle on its base. Press the switch to boil. Pick up the pan. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Press the power button. Crack the eggs into the bowl. Stir the eggs with chopsticks. Pour the egg mixture into the pan. Turn the eggs with the spatula. Pick up the plate. Slide the eggs onto the plate. Pick up the kettle. Pour hot water into the cup. Place the kettle back on the base. Sit down at the table. Eat the breakfast. Drink the water. Pick up the plate and the cup. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for the workday
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Open the wardrobe door. Take out a shirt. Take out a pair of trousers. Lay the clothes on the bed. Take off the sleepwear. Put on the shirt. Button the shirt. Put on the trousers. Put on the socks. Walk to the mirror. Adjust the collar. Comb the hair. Walk back to the bed. Fold the sleepwear. Place it on the bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting up the home workspace, turning on the computer and desk lamp, checking email and reviewing the day's program schedule (working from home due to the transport strike)
enriched_activities.desc: Pull the chair to the desk. Sit down. Press the power button on the computer. Press the switch on the desk lamp. Turn on the desk lamp. Open the computer lid. Type the password on the keyboard. Press Enter. Open the email program. Scroll through the inbox. Click the first message. Read the email. Click reply. Type a reply on the keyboard. Press send. Open the program schedule document. Scroll down the page. Highlight a row with the mouse. Pick up the phone. Check the messages on the phone. Put the phone down on the desk. Pick up the pen. Write the times in the notebook. Put the pen down.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on nonprofit community program coordination: drafting plans, replying to emails, joining video meetings
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at the desk. Type on the keyboard. Open a new document. Draft the program plan. Click the section heading with the mouse. Type the timetable. Scroll the page. Pick up the phone. Answer the call. Say: 'Hello, this is Member 1 from the community program.' Put the phone down. Click the video meeting link. Join the video meeting. Adjust the webcam. Speak into the microphone. Pick up the pen. Note the items in the notebook. Turn the page. Leave the meeting. Close the meeting window. Open the email program. Open a message. Type a reply. Press send. Stand up. Walk to the kitchen. Fill a glass with water. Walk back to Bedroom 1. Sit down at the desk. Continue typing on the keyboard.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating lunch together with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables and the food container. Close the refrigerator door. Place them on the counter. Open the cupboard. Take out two bowls. Open the microwave door. Place the food container inside. Close the microwave door. Press the button on the microwave. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Press the power button. Pour oil into the pan. Add the vegetables. Stir with the spatula. Pick up the plates. Set the plates on the table. Turn to Member 2 and say: 'Lunch is ready.' Sit down at the table. Eat the lunch. Talk with Member 2 about the transport strike. Put the chopsticks down. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Short break resting on the sofa, checking phone, chatting with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the living room. Sit down on the sofa. Lean back on the sofa. Pick up the phone. Unlock the phone. Scroll through the phone screen. Put the phone down on the sofa. Turn the head to Member 2. Ask Member 2: 'Did you finish the illustration draft?' Listen to Member 2's reply. Pick up the phone again. Open a video clip. Watch the screen. Put the phone down. Stand up. Stretch the arms. Walk toward Bedroom 1.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing work: program scheduling, partner communications, updating participant records
enriched_activities.desc: Sit down at the desk. Press the keys on the keyboard. Open the scheduling spreadsheet. Type the participant names into the cells. Click a cell with the mouse. Type the dates. Scroll the table. Open the email program. Write an email to a partner organization. Type the message. Press send. Pick up the phone. Answer the call. Pick up the pen. Take notes on the pad. Put the phone down. Open the record file. Update the participant records. Type the notes on the keyboard. Save the file. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom. Walk back to Bedroom 1. Sit down at the desk. Continue typing.

Walk into the living room. Pick up the cushion from the floor. Place the cushion on the sofa. Pick up the blanket. Fold the blanket. Put the blanket on the sofa arm. Pick up the cups from the coffee table. Walk to the kitchen. Place the cups in the sink. Walk back to the living room. Pick up the remote control from the table. Place the remote control on the shelf. Straighten the magazines on the table. Push the chair back to its place. Pick up the waste paper from the floor. Walk to the bin. Throw the waste paper into the bin.

Walk into the kitchen. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the tomatoes. Take out the meat. Close the refrigerator door. Place the tomatoes and the meat on the cutting board. Turn on the tap. Rinse the tomatoes under the water. Turn off the tap. Pick up the knife. Cut the tomatoes into slices. Place the slices on a plate. Cut the meat into pieces. Place the pieces in a bowl. Pick up the garlic. Peel the garlic with the fingers. Place the garlic on the board. Open the cupboard. Take out a plate. Place the plate on the counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner with the induction cooker and eating together with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Place the pan on the induction cooker. Press the power button. Pour oil into the pan. Add the garlic. Stir with the spatula. Add the meat. Turn the meat over with the spatula. Add the tomatoes. Pour water into the pan. Put the lid on the pan. Press the switch on the range hood. Pick up the plates. Set the plates on the table. Place the chopsticks beside the plates. Press the power button on the induction cooker. Carry the pan to the table. Sit down with Member 2. Eat the dinner. Talk with Member 2 about the day. Put the chopsticks down. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the plates from the table. Carry the plates to the sink. Scrape the leftovers into the bin. Turn on the tap. Rinse the plates. Open the dishwasher door. Place the plates in the dishwasher. Place the chopsticks in the basket. Close the dishwasher door. Press the start button. Pick up the cloth. Wipe the table. Wipe the counter. Rinse the cloth under the tap. Turn off the tap. Hang the cloth on the hook. Turn off the kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing with the TV, watching with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the remote control. Press the power button on the TV. Press the channel button. Place the remote control on the sofa. Lean back on the sofa. Watch the TV screen. Turn the head to Member 2. Talk with Member 2. Pick up the remote control. Press the volume button. Put the remote control down. Change the sitting posture. Sit up. Pick up the phone. Scroll the phone screen. Put the phone down. Watch the TV screen.

enriched_activities.activity: Playing a game on the game console
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up. Walk to the TV stand. Pick up the game controller. Press the power button on the game console. Sit down on the sofa. Hand the second controller to Member 2. Press the button on the controller. Select the game from the menu. Press start. Move the joystick with the thumb. Press the action buttons. Look at the TV screen. Turn the head to Member 2. Press the pause button. Put the controller on the sofa. Pick up the controller again. Continue the game. Press the button. Place the controller on the table. Press the power button on the game console.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bathroom. Open the bathroom door. Turn on the bathroom light. Press the switch on the water heater. Take off the clothes. Place the clothes in the laundry basket. Turn on the shower tap. Step under the water. Wet the hair. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into the hand. Rub the hair. Rinse the hair. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap on the body. Rinse the body. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Dry the body. Dry the hair. Put on the pajamas. Press the switch on the water heater. Turn off the bathroom light.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down, reading and checking phone under the desk lamp with the fan on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Press the button on the fan. Sit down on the bed. Pick up the book from the bedside table. Open the book. Turn the page. Read the page. Pick up the phone from the bed. Unlock the phone. Scroll the phone screen. Put the phone down on the bedside table. Turn the page of the book. Read another page. Close the book. Place the book on the bedside table. Press the switch on the desk lamp. Turn off the desk lamp.

Lie down on the bed. Pull the quilt over the body. Adjust the pillow with the hand. Place the phone on the bedside table. Close the eyes. Turn onto the left side. Pull the quilt up to the shoulder. Reach to the fan. Press the button on the fan. Turn onto the back. Shift the legs. Remain lying on the bed. Keep the eyes closed. Turn onto the right side. Remain lying still. Sleep through the night.
